key_insight: Fully fine-tuning a pretrained TimeSformer video model outperformed classifier-only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline for identifying HFrEF from echocardiography videos.
clinical_relevance: Video foundation models could support echocardiography-based HFrEF assessment, but clinical utility remains unestablished.
method: Fine-tuned TimeSformer on apical four-chamber videos from the public RVENet A4C dataset.
Generated phase-aware clips capturing complementary systolic and diastolic dynamics.
Used divided space-time attention, layer-wise learning rate decay, and multi-clip inference.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on RVENet A4C favored full fine-tuning over classifier-only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline; the abstract reports no numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: External validation is not described in the abstract, leaving generalizability across clinical settings uncertain.
paper_title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
